indie rock darlings Grand Duchy, the five-member Dawes recently settled in Northern California — and they're ready to put in all those hours at their new 1,600-square-foot outpost.
The band's self-titled debut is easy, with its "modern" (read: updated classic rock) sound, a well-muscled yet accessible 12-song mix with good beats, and a more than passable lead singer in Taylor Goldsworthy. But Dawes aren't just your typical old-school rock band with some modern cred – the band's rootsy rock with a touch of pop production is part of their charm. Goldsworthy is good at writing pop songs, as he showed during his time in the very pop Grand Duchy, but the best things are his raw vocals, which are either soaring and angelic or raspy and heartbreaking.
